posts.title: Simplicity by Mattie Lubchansky
posts.description: Tags: book, review 4/5 stars I’ve been familiar with Mattie Lubchansky’s distinctive drawing for a good while (RIP The Nib ) and was thrilled to discover she made a graphic novel. Simplicity is set in the outskirts of what used to be New York City — turned into a walled off city state with oppressive "security", tracking and gig economy turned up to eleven.
